Block inventory

Try a control, then revisit the calendar or quote.

Working assumptions: Zen has 2 rooms and Bougan’villa has 3. On weekdays, rooms can be booked separately and shared spaces are shared. A full-villa booking blocks every room in that villa. An entire-property booking blocks both villas. These remain owner-confirmation items.

Calendar key

Availability is calculated per stay, not merely per day.

  • Available to start a stay
  • Some rooms remain, but a private villa is not available
  • Sold, owner-blocked, or unavailable

Choose dates first. The next step shows only accommodation that remains available for the entire stay.
